name: Ham Casserole
description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

keywords: ham casserole, potato casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Crunchy Top Ham and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole with a crunchy corn flake topping.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all casserole ingredients and mix well.
Place the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine topping ingredients (melted butter and crushed corn flakes) and sprinkle on top of the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: ham and potato casserole, crunchy topping, comforting casserole

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Cabbage Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy cabbage casserole with a crunchy bread crumb topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cabbage wedges until tender, then drain and cut into large pieces.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour, and milk. Season with salt, grated cheese, and Cheez Whiz.
Combine cooked cabbage with the white sauce mixture.
Top with crumbled buttered bread.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: cabbage casserole, creamy vegetable dish, comforting main course

_similar.name: Delicious Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A classic meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and carrot mixture, topped with a sweet ketchup-mustard glaze.

recipeInstructions.text: Beat eggs in a bowl with a fork, then add milk, salt, pepper, and crumbled bread. Beat until the bread disintegrates.
Add chopped onion, shredded carrot, cheddar cheese, and ground beef to the bowl. Mix well.
Pack the mixture into a loaf pan.
Combine brown sugar, ketchup, and prepared mustard in a small bowl. Spread this glaze over the meatloaf.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: meatloaf, cheddar cheese, ketchup glaze, classic American

_similar.name: Ham & Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A layered ham, potato, and cheese casserole cooked in a slow cooker.
recipeIngredient: Cream of mushroom or celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Put half of the ham, potatoes, onions, cheese, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker.
Add the remaining half of the ingredients for the second layer.
Top with soup and sprinkle with paprika.
Cook on slow for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 hours.
